message.skyabyss.whisper.heart: Defeat what beats within, and the way will open

item.skyabyss.captain_pike.desc: Reaches a frontal arc. Every third hit erupts bone
item.skyabyss.waterway_fang.desc: +30%% attack speed underwater. Hits cause bleeding

skilltree.skyabyss.star.desc: Arts of Spirit. They are said to shield with moonlight and slow the flow of time.
skilltree.skyabyss.abyss.desc: Arts of Spirit and Vitality. They are said to strike with a heartbeat and slip into shadow.
skill.skyabyss.titan_cleave.flavor: Cut the mountain, the people of the back taught. Mountains sometimes walk.
skill.skyabyss.titan_cleave.effect: Hits up to 5 foes in a cone ahead (radius 4) for %1$s%% of your attack damage. Large foes (captain, heart, golems...) take %2$sx that.
skill.skyabyss.riposte.flavor: The whalebone guards strike back as hard as they are struck.
skill.skyabyss.riposte.effect: Within %2$s seconds after a creature hurts you, your next melee hit deals +%1$s%%.
skill.skyabyss.lunge.flavor: The distance belongs to whoever steps in.
skill.skyabyss.lunge.effect: Close in on a foe you look at within %1$s blocks and strike for %2$s%% of your attack damage. Only on solid ground; never steps off a ledge.
skill.skyabyss.stone_stance.flavor: Stone is not swept away. The current bends instead.
skill.skyabyss.whale_sweep.flavor: What swims through the sky sweeps everything aside with its tail.
skill.skyabyss.whale_sweep.effect: Spin and hit every foe around you (radius %1$s) for %2$s%% of your attack damage, pushing them back a little.
skill.skyabyss.cloud_pierce.flavor: Something is still out there, beyond the clouds.
skill.skyabyss.cloud_pierce.effect: Loose a straight-flying arrow without drawing (uses 1 arrow). Damage %1$s, pierces up to %2$s foes. Bow enchantments apply.
skill.skyabyss.far_shot.flavor: Eyes that see far can shoot far.
skill.skyabyss.far_shot.effect: Projectiles deal more the farther the target. Up to +%1$s%% (at %2$s blocks or more).
skill.skyabyss.backstep.effect: Hop backwards. Only on solid ground with a foe within %1$s blocks.
skill.skyabyss.hawk_eye.effect: Your arrows mark foes for %2$s seconds (they glow). Marked foes take +%1$s%% damage from everyone.
skill.skyabyss.sky_rain.flavor: Sometimes the sky takes your side.
skill.skyabyss.sky_rain.effect: Light falls %2$s times on a radius-%1$s area you look at (24 blocks). %3$s damage each, grows with Agility. Foes only; no arrows used.

commands.skyabyss.playtest.help.5: trials <titan>: 試練・石を済ませ、扉を開ける
commands.skyabyss.playtest.help.6: gear <0-4|titan>: その章の装備・体力・レベル
commands.skyabyss.playtest.help.11: 例: board whale @a → trials whale @a → goto whale heart @a
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.awake: Triggered the waking scene. Look around and start walking
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.camp: Revealed the camp clue. Look for the camp with the notebook
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.trail: Rang the trail bell. Head toward the sound
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.footprint: Unlocked the giant footprints lore. Go see the footprints
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.shadow: Sent the shadow across the sky. Look up
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.storytell: Spawned the storyteller in front of you. Talk to them
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.footsteps: Played the night footsteps (set to night). Listen and wait
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.isana: Spawned Isana in front of you. Talk to her
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.bones: Unlocked the bone hill lore. Read it
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.song: Played the sky song (set to night). Listen to the end
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.whale: Set dusk, played the whale first sight and lowered the chains. Right-click a chain to climb
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.titan: Brought the next titan down nearby. Board its back by the path (chains etc.)
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.heart: Cleared the trials and moved you before the heart. Go through the doors and fight the heart
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.all_done: Every heart is already stopped. Nothing more to trigger
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.unknown: This step cannot be triggered by playtest now
commands.skyabyss.playtest.board_failed: [Playtest] Could not get on the back (titan far away, boarding gate, or still loading). Try again or use now
message.skyabyss.revive.down_self: You are down... wait for a party member to lift you (%s s)
message.skyabyss.revive.down_mate: %s is down. Hold use on them to revive
message.skyabyss.ping.alone: The "here" ping works only with a party
message.skyabyss.badge.best: Your best in the record book was updated
item.skyabyss.glow_anemone.desc: Held in the hand, it faintly lights the dark water. Fish stay calm near it.
item.skyabyss.glow_anemone.desc2: Three stands, three lamps. Light every stand and the exit door opens.
message.skyabyss.lamp_enough: You can light only %s lamps. It is bright enough
message.skyabyss.lamp_needs: A lamp stand (%s in all). Touch it holding a glowing anemone
message.skyabyss.lamp_bed_take: You picked a glowing anemone (carrying %s / %s, as many as there are stands)
message.skyabyss.lamp_bed_full: Nothing to pick now (lit and carried already make %s, one per stand). Light one and it grows back
message.skyabyss.lamp_one_at_a_time: The waterway weighs more on a replay. You can carry only two lights at a time
message.skyabyss.lamp_bed_dormant: This bed is dormant. Pick lights at the beds by the entrance
message.skyabyss.lamp_tally: Tally stone: lamps %s / %s. Light every stand and the exit door opens
message.skyabyss.lamp_gate_open: Deep in the waterway, a heavy door opened. Make for the bubble column
message.skyabyss.lamp_band_open: Lamps %s / %s  Door open. Find the bubble column at the exit
message.skyabyss.whisper.maze_entry: Pick three glowing anemones from the bed and kindle the three lamp stands in the dark water. When all are lit the exit door opens and a path of light runs along the floor. Fish stay calm near a lamp. When your breath runs short, head for a glowing bubble column
message.skyabyss.lamp_band_bed: Lamps %s / %s  No lamp. Pick one at a bed
message.skyabyss.lamp_open_sub: The exit is a bubble column. Search the dark channels
skilltree.skyabyss.rock.desc: Close-range arts of Strength and Endurance. Draw the foe's aim and stand as the party's wall.
skilltree.skyabyss.wind.desc: Quick close-range offense of Agility. Lunge, leap away, and cut twice from behind.
skilltree.skyabyss.tide.desc: Support and disruption sung with Spirit. Shield allies with absorption and mana, slow foes. No healing.
skilltree.skyabyss.ash.desc: Fiery melee of Strength and Spirit. Set your weapon aglow and scorch the ground with a hammer.
skilltree.skyabyss.bone.desc: Long-range shooting of Agility. Piercing arrows, traps and marks that lift the whole party's damage.
skilltree.skyabyss.traveler.desc: A common tree anyone may take. Signals, readiness, camp craft, and a journal that carries your runes.
skill.skyabyss.rock_call.flavor: "Here," calls the rock, and the foe stops and turns.
skill.skyabyss.rock_call.effect: Draws the aim of every foe within %1$s blocks onto you for %2$s s. Knockback from drawn foes is x%3$s.
skill.skyabyss.stone_oath.flavor: The stone says nothing and bears the party's weight.
skill.skyabyss.stone_oath.effect: Take %1$s%% of the damage allies within %3$s blocks would take (up to %2$s heart per hit). They lose less; you lose more.
skill.skyabyss.nimble.flavor: The people of the back walk with their steps lent to the wind.
skill.skyabyss.nimble.effect: Ground movement is %1$s%% faster, and falls hurt %2$s blocks less.
skill.skyabyss.foresight.flavor: Knowing what comes, a hair's breadth is enough.
skill.skyabyss.foresight.effect: For %2$s s after a foe's telegraph (circle or line) ends without hitting you, attack speed is %1$s%% higher.
skill.skyabyss.wind_rend.flavor: The wind tears the same place twice. A back is the wind's road.
skill.skyabyss.wind_rend.effect: Two quick cuts. Each hits for %2$s%% of your attack from the front, %1$s%% from behind.
skill.skyabyss.lone_wind.flavor: A wind that left the herd runs fastest.
skill.skyabyss.lone_wind.effect: While no other player is within %3$s blocks: attack +%1$s%%, movement +%2$s%%. Does nothing with company (the solo path).
skill.skyabyss.ward_song.flavor: A sea song guards once, like a bubble.
skill.skyabyss.ward_song.effect: Grants allies within %1$s blocks (you included) %2$s absorption (%3$s yellow hearts) for %4$s s. Does not stack.
skill.skyabyss.calm_heart.flavor: In a calm chest, strength fills slowly.
skill.skyabyss.calm_heart.effect: Mana regeneration for you and nearby allies is %1$s%% faster (the highest only; no stacking).
skill.skyabyss.ebb_tide.flavor: The ebbing wave takes the sand from under your feet.
skill.skyabyss.ebb_tide.effect: Pulls foes within %1$s blocks ahead to your feet and slows them for %2$s s. Large foes are only slowed.
skill.skyabyss.ripple.flavor: What is touched keeps the wave.
skill.skyabyss.ripple.effect: Foes hit by your skills move %1$s%% slower for %2$s s. Half against large foes.
skill.skyabyss.cycle_song.flavor: The song goes round once and steadies the breath.
skill.skyabyss.cycle_song.effect: Speeds mana regeneration of allies within %1$s blocks by %3$s%% for %2$s s (%4$s%% for you).
skill.skyabyss.chorus_voice.flavor: One voice carries farther the more voices join.
skill.skyabyss.chorus_voice.effect: For each ally within %3$s blocks, your skills are %1$s%% stronger (up to %2$s allies). Nothing alone.
skill.skyabyss.temper.flavor: A blade the color of embers breathes with each swing.
skill.skyabyss.temper.effect: Sets your weapon aglow for %1$s s. Attacks add %2$s%% of attack as fire damage and burn the foe for %3$s s. Aim at yourself or one ally in view (%4$s blocks).
skill.skyabyss.ember_heart.flavor: One who knows fire is slow to burn.
skill.skyabyss.ember_heart.effect: Fire damage you take is %1$s%% lower.
skill.skyabyss.ember_hammer.flavor: Ground that is struck does not sleep for a while.
skill.skyabyss.ember_hammer.effect: Slams ahead (radius %1$s) for %2$s%% of attack. Embers stay %3$s s and burn only foes.
skill.skyabyss.forge_memory.flavor: The forge remembers as much heat as it has been struck.
skill.skyabyss.forge_memory.effect: Each skill use gathers one ember (up to %1$s). Your next melee hit is %2$s%% stronger per ember (all are spent).
skill.skyabyss.ash_scatter.flavor: Under ash, fang and arrow both dull.
skill.skyabyss.ash_scatter.effect: Foes within %1$s blocks are Ash-Covered for %2$s s: attack -%3$s%%, projectile speed -%4$s%%.
skill.skyabyss.smith_eye.flavor: The more a blade is forged, the more it answers the art.
skill.skyabyss.smith_eye.effect: Skill damage rises %1$s%% per enhancement level of your held weapon (%2$s%% at +10).
skill.skyabyss.bone_trap.flavor: Bone is good at waiting to be stepped on.
skill.skyabyss.bone_trap.effect: Sets a bone trap at your feet (up to %1$s). A foe that steps on it is bound for %2$s s and takes %3$s%% of attack. Large foes are not bound and take %4$s%%.
skill.skyabyss.still_string.flavor: The arrow of one who draws and waits is heavy.
skill.skyabyss.still_string.effect: An arrow (or Cloud Pierce) loosed after standing still for %2$s s deals %1$s%% more. Moving resets it.
skill.skyabyss.signal.flavor: Light carries even where no voice does.
skill.skyabyss.signal.effect: Marks where you look for your party. On a foe: everyone deals +%3$s%% damage to it for %4$s s. On ground: a %2$s s waypoint (range %1$s).
message.skyabyss.signal.place: %1$s planted a marker. Head for the pillar of light (%2$s s)
skill.skyabyss.readiness_reward.flavor: The road is kind to those who prepared.
skill.skyabyss.readiness_reward.effect: While all three lamps (body, blade, provisions) are blue: max mana +%1$s, attack +%2$s%%.
skill.skyabyss.camp_hand.flavor: Hands work well beside a fire.
skill.skyabyss.camp_hand.effect: Near a campfire or resonance forge, mana regenerates x%1$s and hunger drains %2$s%% less.
skill.skyabyss.appraiser.flavor: An eye for worth helps the purse too.
skill.skyabyss.appraiser.effect: Respecs at the resonance forge cost 1 fewer crystal (when 2 or more). Affix tooltips show the value range.
skill.skyabyss.fleet_foot.flavor: Running away is a fine art too.
skill.skyabyss.fleet_foot.effect: When your health drops to %1$s hearts or less, movement is %2$s%% faster for %3$s s (once per %4$s s).
skill.skyabyss.journal.flavor: Written down, it can be picked up anywhere.
skill.skyabyss.journal.effect: While out of combat, switch runes and saved loadouts anywhere, without a forge or fire.
rune.skyabyss.wide_blade.effect: The cone widens to 180 degrees. Power -10%.
rune.skyabyss.deep_blade.effect: The cone narrows to 30 degrees and hits only the nearest foe for x1.4.
rune.skyabyss.ground_run.effect: No cone; a shockwave 8 blocks long and 1.5 wide runs along the ground.
rune.skyabyss.pincer.effect: Pulls struck foes to your feet (large foes do not move).
rune.skyabyss.heavy_voice.effect: While foes are drawn, damage taken -10%.
rune.skyabyss.rock_return.effect: Each time a drawn foe hits you, your next melee +10%.
rune.skyabyss.pass_through.effect: Land behind the foe (if there is footing).
rune.skyabyss.chain_lunge.effect: On a hit, the cooldown is halved.
rune.skyabyss.pierce_through.effect: Every foe on the path takes x0.6 damage.
rune.skyabyss.return_fire.effect: For 3 s after the leap, projectile damage x1.2.
rune.skyabyss.wind_remnant.effect: A whirl stays 2 s where you stood and slows foes.
rune.skyabyss.back_take.effect: x1.8 from behind, x0.75 from the front.
rune.skyabyss.bleed.effect: The cut foe bleeds for 3 s (damage over time).
rune.skyabyss.companion_wind.effect: Nearby allies move 10% faster for 4 s.
rune.skyabyss.cycling_song.effect: When the absorption breaks, half passes to a nearby ally.
rune.skyabyss.strong_tide.effect: Large foes are pulled about a block too.
rune.skyabyss.whirl.effect: A whirl stays 2 s there, Slowness III.
rune.skyabyss.push_back.effect: Pushes ahead instead of pulling (to a wall).
rune.skyabyss.fire_pillar.effect: Radius narrows to 1.5; the foe at the center takes x1.8.
rune.skyabyss.lightning.effect: A small bolt (30% of the hit) jumps to another foe near the one struck.
breakpoint.skyabyss.strength_15: Strength 15: heavy weapons (greatsword, axe, hammer) recover 8% faster after a swing
breakpoint.skyabyss.agility_15: Agility 15: for 2 s after dodging a telegraph, movement +8%
breakpoint.skyabyss.agility_30: Agility 30: Lunge, Backstep and Wind Rend recover 10% faster
breakpoint.skyabyss.spirit_30: Spirit 30: skills aimed at allies (songs, marking) are 10% stronger
gui.skyabyss.skill.loadout_load_tip: Switch to loadout %1$s (slots, runes, chains; points stay). %2$s. Near a forge or campfire, out of combat; anywhere with the Traveler's Journal.
gui.skyabyss.skill.loadout_save_tip: Press Save, then a number, to store the current slots, runes and chains in loadout %1$s (%2$s).
gui.skyabyss.skill.main_stat_none: A common tree anyone may take
gui.skyabyss.skill.rune_locked: Runes open once you master a skill.
gui.skyabyss.skill.slot_locked: This slot opens with the second calling (after chapter 3).
gui.skyabyss.skill.respec_early: Until level %3$s, respec anywhere for free.
gui.skyabyss.skill.rank_capped: Skills outside your calling trees stop at rank %s.
gui.skyabyss.skill.need_calling: Choosing a calling opens this row.
gui.skyabyss.skill.need_calling_deep: Only a calling tree goes this deep.
gui.skyabyss.skill.before_calling: A calling is a specialty: its tree's keystone is yours, you gain an innate trait, and 3 ranks of that tree cost 1 point less. Every tree is open from the start.
message.skyabyss.skill.rune_failed.not_a: That rune cannot be chosen yet.
message.skyabyss.skill.rune_failed.not_q: Runes can be swapped only out of combat (30 s without hurting or being hurt).
message.skyabyss.skill.rune_failed.no_pl: Swap near a forge or campfire (anywhere with the Journal).
message.skyabyss.skill.loadout_failed.em: That set is not saved yet.
message.skyabyss.skill.loadout_failed.no: Sets switch only out of combat (30 s).
Switch near a forge or campfire (anywhere with the Journal).
message.skyabyss.skill.learn_failed.call: This stays closed until a calling is chosen.
calling.skyabyss.rock.role: Wall. Draw aim and stand before allies.
calling.skyabyss.wind.trait.desc: Telegraph edges look slightly bolder. Movement +3%.
calling.skyabyss.wind.role: Mobile close offense. Backs and speed.
calling.skyabyss.tide.trait.desc: Max mana +10, ally-aimed skills reach +1 block.
calling.skyabyss.tide.role: Support and disruption. Absorption, mana, slowing.
calling.skyabyss.ash.role: Fiery melee offense. Embers and hammer.
calling.skyabyss.bone.trait.desc: Projectile damage +5%; 25% of arrows shot are not spent.
calling.skyabyss.bone.role: Ranged offense and traps. Marks lift damage.
gui.skyabyss.calling.title: Choose a Calling
gui.skyabyss.calling.lead: The titan sleeps. What will your hands inherit?
gui.skyabyss.calling.lead2: The thunder wing sleeps. Your hands learned more.
gui.skyabyss.calling.deep: You receive this tree's keystone and an innate trait; 3 ranks of this tree cost 1 point less.
gui.skyabyss.calling.deep2: You receive this tree's keystone. One more skill slot.
message.skyabyss.calling.offer: The titan sleeps. Your hands look for something to inherit. (Choose a calling from the K screen.)
message.skyabyss.calling.offer2: The thunder-wing sleeps too. You may inherit a second calling. (From the K screen.)
legend.skyabyss.pike_bone.effect: Pierces everyone on the path; every third time bone erupts underfoot.
legend.skyabyss.fang_bite.effect: Two cuts become three, and the damage from behind becomes bleeding (3 s).
legend.skyabyss.shears_cut.effect: Freezes struck foes for 1 s (0.5 s for large foes).
legend.skyabyss.harpoon_tie.effect: Instead of pulling, ties foes with a harpoon. When a tied foe moves, its neighbors are dragged too.
legend.skyabyss.claw_ring.effect: The start and landing points are joined by a ring of thunder; foes between take x0.8.
legend.skyabyss.halberd_hook.effect: Gathers drawn foes into one spot (the pack clumps).
legend.skyabyss.hammer_forge.effect: Embers last 8 s; foes standing in them deal 10% less.
legend.skyabyss.poker_share.effect: Temper up to two allies at once.
gui.skyabyss.skill.legend_need: Works only while you hold that weapon. Requires %s.
objective.skyabyss.trial_west: Cross the valley, reach the west goal
objective.skyabyss.trial_east_e1: Clear the first hall, go north
objective.skyabyss.trial_east_ck: Fell the Elder, open the tally door
objective.skyabyss.trial_heart: Pass the north seal to the heart
stance.skyabyss.none.desc: No stance. No bonuses or penalties.
stance.skyabyss.guard.desc: Armor +3, knockback resistance +15%%. Damage dealt -10%%. Stand and take it.
stance.skyabyss.swift.desc: Movement +8%%, skill cooldowns -8%%. Armor -2. Stay on your feet.
stance.skyabyss.song.desc: Mana regen +35%%, support amounts +15%%. Damage dealt -10%%. Carry the party.
tag.skyabyss.wind.cond: 3 s after dodging a telegraph: damage +5%% / +8%%
tag.skyabyss.ash.cond: 4 s after a clean dodge (no hits for 5 s): damage +6%% / +10%%
tag.skyabyss.bone.cond: At 3 hearts or less: projectile damage +8%% / +12%%
rune.skyabyss.mastery.effect: A 4th rune that opens at mastery %1$s. Skill power +10%%, cooldown -8%% (mastery now %2$s).
gui.skyabyss.skill.loadout_mode_tip: Toggles save mode: the next number you press stores the current slots, runes and chains there. %1$s loadouts.
gui.skyabyss.skill.tryon_locked: While trying on you can only learn skills.
gui.skyabyss.skill.tryon_tip: Allocate points provisionally to check effects, mana and cooldowns. Nothing changes until you confirm.
gui.skyabyss.skill.tryon_undo_tip: Take back the last provisional point.
gui.skyabyss.skill.tryon_cancel_tip: Drop the try-on and return to your real build.
gui.skyabyss.skill.page_tip: Switch between the tree page and the page for stances, chains, tags and keystones.
gui.skyabyss.skill.mastery_line: Mastery %1$s (%2$s / next %3$s). Grows by casting, hitting, and hitting right after a dodge.
gui.skyabyss.skill.mastery_locked: Opens at mastery %s. Cast, hit and hit after dodges to grow it.
gui.skyabyss.skill.stance_tip: Cycle with %1$s. After a swap wait %2$s s.
gui.skyabyss.skill.chain_tip: Link neighbouring slots. Using the next slot's skill within %2$s s of the previous gives it +%3$s%% power. Up to %1$s chains.
gui.skyabyss.skill.tag_count: Count %1$s (skills %2$s, gear etc. %3$s). Power of this tag's skills +%4$s%%.
gui.skyabyss.skill.keystone_hint: 1 point each. Remove out of combat. Needs %s points in that tree
message.skyabyss.skill.stance_cooldown: Wait a moment before swapping stance
message.skyabyss.skill.keystone_failed.n: Remove it out of combat (30 s)
message.skyabyss.skill.tryon_partial: Only %1$s of %2$s were learned (a condition was not met)
skill.skyabyss.dust_charge.flavor: Rock, carried by the wind, becomes a wall of sand.
skill.skyabyss.dust_charge.effect: Rush %1$s blocks forward, striking foes on the path for %2$s%% attack and shoving them aside. Cooldown %3$s s.
skill.skyabyss.sea_breeze.flavor: A tailwind always smells of the sea.
skill.skyabyss.steam_bell.flavor: Ash-heat touched the tide, and became a bell.
skill.skyabyss.steam_bell.effect: Strike foes around you (radius %1$s) for %2$s%% attack and slow them by %3$s%% (%4$s s).
skill.skyabyss.cinder_volley.flavor: Fire the arrows in numbers, and the sky turns red.
skill.skyabyss.cinder_volley.effect: Loose %1$s fire bolts in a fan. Each hits up to 2 foes for %2$s%% attack (range %3$s blocks) and sets them alight for %4$s s.
skill.skyabyss.stone_aim.flavor: The arrow of one who stands still is as calm as a stone.
skill.skyabyss.stone_aim.effect: After standing still for %2$s s: Bone-tag skills +%1$s%% power, armor +%3$s.
skill.skyabyss.deep_pull.flavor: The deep tugs, a little, at those who look in.
skill.skyabyss.deep_pull.effect: Draw foes around you (radius %1$s) to a point ahead and strike for %2$s%% attack. Slow them by %3$s%% (%4$s s).
skill.skyabyss.deep_mirror.flavor: The more you mix, the deeper the mirror.
skill.skyabyss.deep_mirror.effect: While you count %2$s or more different tags, all skills +%1$s%% power.
skill.skyabyss.deep_echo.flavor: The skill that should have ended is still ringing.
skill.skyabyss.deep_echo.effect: For %2$s s, all skills +%1$s%% power (deals no damage itself). Cooldown %3$s s.
skill.skyabyss.deep_tithe.flavor: Not for the one with plenty: an offering from the deep to the one with few.
skill.skyabyss.deep_tithe.effect: Of your tags other than the most numerous, the %1$s largest (with at least 1) each count +1.
skill.skyabyss.deep_maw.flavor: If the deep has a mouth, it is smiling.
skill.skyabyss.deep_maw.effect: Drag foes within radius %1$s of where you look (up to %3$s blocks) in, then bite for %2$s%% attack 0.4 s later. Cooldown %4$s s.
skill.skyabyss.deep_oath.flavor: The deep swears only to one who holds all five colors.
skill.skyabyss.deep_oath.effect: While you count at least one of each tag (Rock, Wind, Tide, Ash, Bone): all skills +%1$s%% power, mana regeneration +%2$s%%.
skill.skyabyss.echo_strike.flavor: The lingering scent of the last blow of a past life.
skill.skyabyss.echo_strike.effect: Strike one foe ahead (within %2$s blocks) for %1$s%% attack in total: 65%% now, 35%% as an echo 0.5 s later.
skill.skyabyss.old_vigil.flavor: Where the eyes rest of one who has counted the nights.
skill.skyabyss.grave_bell.flavor: When it tolls, the person you once were stops in their tracks.
skill.skyabyss.grave_bell.effect: Strike foes around you (radius %1$s) for %2$s%% attack and slow them by %3$s%% (%4$s s).
skill.skyabyss.memory_edge.flavor: With every rebirth the blade is honed a little.
skill.skyabyss.memory_edge.effect: Per rebirth, skills +%2$s%% power x rank (up to %3$s rebirths; this rank's cap is +%1$s%%).
skill.skyabyss.final_light.flavor: The last moment of a past life, once more.
skill.skyabyss.final_light.effect: Rings of light spread three times; foes around you (radius %1$s) take %2$s%% attack and are pushed out. Cooldown %3$s s.
skill.skyabyss.soul_thread.flavor: However often it is tied, the thread never breaks in the same place.
skilltree.skyabyss.hybrid.desc: Skills for those who mix: open when you know 3 skills in each of two adjacent trees. One on each edge of the ring, five in all.
skilltree.skyabyss.deep.desc: A sixth tree open only to the reborn. Entry at rebirth 1, every tier by rebirth 5. Built around skills meant to be mixed into the other trees.
skilltree.skyabyss.past.desc: Skills of a past life, opened by your rebirth count. Their points are a separate pool (2 per rebirth, up to 12).
mutation.skyabyss.cleave_cliff.effect: Instead of a fan, a column of rock 10 blocks long and 3 wide heaves up. 80%% damage (x1.5 more on large foes), up to 5 foes.
mutation.skyabyss.sweep_tail.effect: One sweep becomes two spreading rings: 60%% in the inner ring, 60%% again in the outer ring 0.4 s later (with a shove).
mutation.skyabyss.rend_blade.effect: A crescent blade flies 12 blocks forward, hitting up to 3 foes, and returns 0.4 s later for 80%% more.
mutation.skyabyss.rain_comet.effect: The six pulses of rain become one great star: after 0.6 s it falls on radius 3.5 for 85%% of the six pulses.
mutation.skyabyss.ebb_whirl.effect: Foes on every side are drawn into one point and slowed. The whirl lingers.
mutation.skyabyss.lunge_surge.effect: Even with no target, dash 8 blocks forward like water, cutting everyone in your path.
mutation.skyabyss.hammer_meteor.effect: A ball of fire falls 6 blocks ahead; 0.5 s later it deals the hammer's damage and leaves an ember bed.
mutation.skyabyss.trap_mine.effect: Instead of a binding trap, bury a fire mine where you look. When stepped on (or after 6 s) it blasts radius 3 and burns.
glyph.skyabyss.ash.effect: Center skill +%1$s%% power (does not reach neighbors).
glyph.skyabyss.bone.effect: Center skill cooldown -%1$s%% (does not reach neighbors).
gui.skyabyss.ext.mutation_head: Skill mutations (titan materials, one per skill)
gui.skyabyss.ext.mutation_done: Mutated. Cannot be undone. Works alongside runes.
gui.skyabyss.ext.mutation_once: Permanent once chosen. Power, cooldown and mana stay the same; only the shape changes.
gui.skyabyss.ext.mutation_master: Available once the skill is mastered.
gui.skyabyss.ext.bag_empty: Glyphs drop when you clear a trial
gui.skyabyss.ext.hint_pick: Pick a center skill first (one you know)
message.skyabyss.skill.glyph_full: Your glyph bag is full. Free some space
message.skyabyss.skill.ext_failed.closed: That socket is not open yet (opens with rebirth)
message.skyabyss.skill.ext_failed.bad_sk: The center must be a skill you know
message.skyabyss.room_trap: Step on a floor plate and it crumbles or bursts a moment later. Lure the enemies onto it
objective.skyabyss.trial_board: Read the Trial Board to see your trials
objective.skyabyss.trial_deck: Go up to the Trial Hall
objective.skyabyss.trial_door: Enter your trial through the marked door
advancement.skyabyss.bone_pit.title: The Bone Pit
advancement.skyabyss.bone_pit.descriptio:
Ch. I Stone Whale: Deep in the pit, someone's pack was left behind.
Reward: 3 bell coins
advancement.skyabyss.whale_trail.title: Ready to Chase the Whale
advancement.skyabyss.whale_trail.descrip:
Ch. I Stone Whale: Iron on, blade honed, shield and provisions on your back.
Reward: 10 bell coins
advancement.skyabyss.scorched_watch.desc:
Ch. III Thunder Wing: Lightning kept falling on the pillar atop the tower.
Reward: 3 bell coins
advancement.skyabyss.storm_trail.title: Ready for the Peaks
advancement.skyabyss.storm_trail.descrip:
Ch. III Thunder Wing: Rods raised, the tower climbed, sky stone in hand.
Reward: 10 bell coins
advancement.skyabyss.salt_vault.title: The Sunken Salt Vault
advancement.skyabyss.salt_vault.descript:
Ch. II Tide Shell: On the vault's back wall, someone had carved words.
Reward: 3 bell coins
advancement.skyabyss.tide_trail.title: Ready to Cross the Tide
advancement.skyabyss.tide_trail.descript:
Ch. II Tide Shell: You walked the salt road and rowed to the wreck offshore.
Reward: 10 bell coins
advancement.skyabyss.achievement.root.de: Things done along the way. Each pays bell coins.
advancement.skyabyss.achievement.shop.de:
Bought something at a capital shop.
Reward: 5 bell coins
advancement.skyabyss.achievement.trade.d:
Swapped goods with another traveller at the trading post.
Reward: 10 bell coins
advancement.skyabyss.achievement.quest.d:
Saw a request through to the end.
Reward: 5 bell coins
advancement.skyabyss.achievement.board.d:
Finished a request from the message board.
Reward: 5 bell coins
advancement.skyabyss.achievement.town.de:
Helped someone in the capital.
Reward: 10 bell coins
advancement.skyabyss.achievement.guild.d:
Founded or joined a guild.
Reward: 10 bell coins
Reset your skills or stats with the training master.
Reward: 3 bell coins
advancement.skyabyss.achievement.grave.d:
Took your things back from your grave.
Reward: 3 bell coins
advancement.skyabyss.dead_forge_pit.desc:
Ch. IV Ember: A torn page lay on the cold anvil.
Reward: 3 bell coins
advancement.skyabyss.ember_trail.title: Ready for the Ash
advancement.skyabyss.ember_trail.descrip:
Ch. IV Ember: Fire draughts brewed, the forge page found.
Reward: 10 bell coins
abyss_art.light.effect: Places a light. Enemies in its glow show their outline. The caster gets night vision.
abyss_art.weight.effect: Eases the rising weight. Only for the caster.
abyss_art.heartbeat.effect: Hears enemy heartbeats through walls and shows them. Heals nearby allies.
message.skyabyss.art.tree_open: The Abyss Art tree is open. Sneak and press the key to raise an art.
message.skyabyss.art.need_tree: Open the Abyss Art tree at the ash pool before raising arts
message.skyabyss.art.light_placed: Light placed. Enemies in it are visible.
message.skyabyss.raid.wipe: Everyone is down. Back to the room entrance
trial.skyabyss.cell.WR1.desc: Carry three glowing bone orbs to the altar. Holding one slows you and stops jumping, and enemies hunt the carrier. A dropped orb returns to its place.
trial.skyabyss.cell.WR2.desc: Strike the four corner bones in the order they ring. A chord can be struck together by two players. A wrong note costs no health; the song replays.
trial.skyabyss.cell.WR3.desc: Defend the core at the room's centre through three waves. If its health runs out, the room starts over.
raid.skyabyss.WR1.carry: Carry the bone orbs to the altar (slow, no jumping while holding one)
raid.skyabyss.WR1.carrying: To the altar! Enemies are hunting the carrier
raid.skyabyss.WR2.strike: Strike the bones in the same order (chords together)
message.skyabyss.raid.WR3.broken: The whale core shattered. Back to the room entrance
trial.skyabyss.cell.WR4.desc: Stomach fluid slowly rises from the bottom of the shaft. Strike a bone stud and a staircase to the next landing grows for a while. Split the work between the one who strikes and those who climb.
trial.skyabyss.cell.WR5.desc: The floor tiles turn when struck. Join the whale's bones to match the pattern carved on the north wall. The shape changes every run. A balcony gives a view of everything.
trial.skyabyss.cell.WR6.desc: The safe ring on the floor slowly shrinks. Outside it the floor turns red and hurts anyone standing there. Defeat three waves inside the ring.
raid.skyabyss.WR4.climb: Climb to the top (strike a bone stud to grow a staircase)
raid.skyabyss.WR5.align: Strike tiles to turn them and join the bones as on the wall
message.skyabyss.raid.WR4.filled: The fluid has filled the shaft. Back to the room entrance
trial.skyabyss.cell.ER1.desc: Carry three embers from the vent to the cold forge before they cool. The carrier is slowly burned and the ember cools by the second. Sneak to hand it to a nearby ally. Vent bursts fire after a red mark.
trial.skyabyss.cell.ER2.desc: Use the four stations in the order shown by the murals (mold, fire, water, hammer). Several players can ready stations beforehand. A wrong order resets the stations; no damage.
trial.skyabyss.cell.ER3.desc: Defend the great forge from three waves. Ash foes try to douse it. Relighting the braziers slows them. If the forge goes out, the room restarts.
trial.skyabyss.cell.ER4.desc: Three plank bridges hang on chains over a sea of embers. Once you step on one, its planks glow red from the near end and fall a second later. Keep walking and you stay ahead. Anyone who falls is returned to the island behind (no damage), and fallen bridges are rehung while someone waits behind.
trial.skyabyss.cell.ER5.desc: Four pressure gauges line the north wall. Right-click a valve to move its needle up one and push the neighbouring needles down one; left-click turns it back. Set all four needles to the same mark to pass. No enemies, no damage.
trial.skyabyss.cell.ER6.desc: Apprentices trained by the ash smith step out one at a time. Each is stronger than the last and has learned one more of the smith's moves. Every attack comes after a red mark. Defeat all four to pass. If everyone falls, the room restarts.
raid.skyabyss.ER1.fetch: Take an ember from the vent (one per player)
raid.skyabyss.ER1.deliver: Carry the ember to the cold forge before it cools (sneak to hand it over)
raid.skyabyss.ER2.charge: Stand on stations to ready them (they glow when ready); read the mural order
raid.skyabyss.ER2.use: Sneak on ready stations in the mural's order
raid.skyabyss.ER2.wrong: Wrong order. The stations cooled and reset
raid.skyabyss.ER3.lost: The forge went out. Back to the room entrance
raid.skyabyss.ER4.cross: Cross before the bridge drops (keep moving; if you fall, restart from the island behind)
raid.skyabyss.ER5.align: Turn the valves until all four needles sit on the same mark (right-click forward, left-click back)
raid.skyabyss.ER5.done: The needles agree. The forge breathes
raid.skyabyss.ER6.fight: Defeat the apprentices (watch for the red marks)
raid.skyabyss.ER6.enter: Apprentice %s of %s steps up to the forge
trial.skyabyss.cell.SR1.desc: On a windy copper deck, carry three glowing lightning feathers to the perches in the east. The carrier is struck on a beat (a red ring shows first). A teammate with a ward charm standing close takes the bolt instead; alone, take it next to a bright grounding plate.
trial.skyabyss.cell.SR2.desc: Strike the copper wire tiles on the floor to turn them and connect the central source to the four lamps. Connected wire glows and the current flows. No enemies; split up to go faster.
trial.skyabyss.cell.SR3.desc: Storm foes charge up over time and glow when full. Defeating a glowing foe arcs lightning to nearby foes. Clear three waves, then defeat the fully charged elite.
raid.skyabyss.SR1.carry: Carry the feathers to the perches (the carrier gets struck)
raid.skyabyss.SR1.carrying: Lightning incoming! Stay near a charm-bearer or a grounding plate
raid.skyabyss.SR2.connect: Connect the source to the lamps (strike a tile to turn it)
raid.skyabyss.SR3.chain: Defeat glowing foes to chain the lightning
raid.skyabyss.SR3.elite: Defeat the charged elite (pop glowing moths next to it)
message.skyabyss.raid.SR1.grounded: The bolt fled into a grounding plate
message.skyabyss.raid.SR1.struck: Struck! The feather returns to its place
trial.skyabyss.cell.TR1.desc: A dark coral hall; only the pearl carrier lights the way. Carry the pearls to the far altar while enemies hunt the carrier. Sneak beside an ally to hand a pearl over.
trial.skyabyss.cell.TR2.desc: Opening a shell plays a tone. Find the shell with the same tone to make a pair. Tones also show as colour and particle shape. A wrong pair costs no health; the shells close.
trial.skyabyss.cell.TR3.desc: Defend three coral saplings from three waves of tide creatures that try to eat them. If all three are lost, the room starts over.
raid.skyabyss.TR1.fetch: Take a pearl from its stand and carry it to the far altar
raid.skyabyss.TR1.carrying: To the altar! Enemies hunt the light (sneak beside an ally to hand over)
raid.skyabyss.TR2.first: Open shells and find the matching tone
raid.skyabyss.TR2.second: Open another shell with the same tone
raid.skyabyss.TR3.ready: Brace for the wave (guard the saplings)
message.skyabyss.raid.TR1.dropped: The light went out. The pearl returned to its stand
message.skyabyss.raid.TR3.lost: The saplings are gone. Back to the room entrance
sign.skyabyss.abyss_shaft.3: Carve the names of those who went down
sign.skyabyss.abyss_gate.2: The sky key melts the bars
sign.skyabyss.abyss_gate.3: Return by the white stone in the bone camp
